definitions.explanation: A family unit living together and the domestic life they share. Emphasizes the social and emotional aspects of family life rather than the physical building.

examples.japanese: {幸|しあわ}せな{家庭|かてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧。
{家庭|かてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Due to family circumstances, we had to move.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{家庭|かてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people find it difficult to balance work and family life.

notes:
{家庭|かてい} combines ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (house) and {庭|てい} (garden, grounds). It refers to the family unit and domestic life, not the physical structure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家庭|かてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧ (to build a home/family)
- {家庭|かてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事情|じじょう}→事情：03272_jijou⟧ (family circumstances)
- {家庭|かてい}{環境|かんきょう} (home environment)
- {家庭|かてい}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (home cooking)
- {家庭|かてい}⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧ (private tutor — literally "home teacher")
- {家庭|かてい}{裁判所|さいばんしょ} (family court)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {家庭|かてい} vs. ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ vs. ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: {家庭|かてい} emphasizes domestic life and the household as a social unit. ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧ refers to the family members themselves. ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧ can mean the physical house, the household, or a family lineage.
